Select Theme

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Anim
    A tiny animation engine built on Timer, so every animation runs safely on the Swing event thread.
    Anim.Value
    A number that glides smoothly to a new value, used for hover effects, counters and so on.
    Badge
    A small pill-shaped label such as "In Progress" or "High".
    EmptyState
    The friendly message shown instead of the task list when there is nothing to display.
    EmptyState.IconDisc
    The big circle with a clipboard icon.
    FieldShell
    A rounded, themed frame around a text component.
    FlatButton
    A modern flat button with rounded corners, an optional vector icon and smooth hover / press animations.
    FlatButton.Variant
    The visual style of a button.
    Gfx
    Small drawing helpers shared by the custom components.
    HintTextField
    A text field that shows grey placeholder text while it is empty.
    Icons
    Vector icons drawn with Java2D.
    Icons.Kind
    The available icons.
    InMemoryTaskRepository
    A TaskRepository that keeps tasks in memory only.
    JsonFileTaskRepository
    Stores tasks in a human-readable JSON file so they survive closing the application.
    Main
    Entry point of the TaskFlow application.
    MainFrame
    The main window of TaskFlow.
    MainFrame.Backdrop
    The window background: a flat colour with a soft blue glow at the top.
    MainFrame.FadeGlass
    Glass pane that fades the old look away when the theme changes.
    MainFrame.ListPanel
    Vertical list of task cards that always matches the width of the scroll pane.
    MainFrame.LogoMark
    The blue rounded square with a tick that serves as the logo.
    MainFrame.Mode
    How cards should animate after the list is rebuilt.
    MiniJson
    A tiny JSON reader/writer, just big enough for the task file: an array of flat objects whose values are strings or null.
    MiniJson.Parser
    Recursive-descent style parser over a character buffer.
    ModernScrollBarUI
    A thin, rounded scroll bar without arrow buttons that follows the current theme.
    Priority
    How important a Task is.
    Reveal
    Wraps a task card and adds enter / exit animations.
    RoundedPanel
    A panel with rounded corners, a thin border and an optional soft shadow.
    SampleData
    Creates a handful of realistic tasks so the application can be demonstrated quickly.
    Segmented
    A segmented control (a row of options where exactly one is selected).
    SortOption
    The ways the task list can be ordered.
    StatsPanel
    The dashboard row at the top of the window: a progress ring plus counters for all tasks, pending, in progress, completed and overdue tasks.
    StatsPanel.ProgressCard
    The wide tile with the progress ring.
    StatsPanel.StatCard
    One counter tile.
    StorageException
    Thrown when tasks cannot be read from or written to permanent storage (for example when the disk is full or the data file is locked).
    Task
    A single to-do item.
    TaskCard
    The visual representation of one task: a status circle, title, description, status / priority / due-date badges and edit / delete buttons.
    TaskCard.Actions
    What the card asks the window to do.
    TaskCard.StatusCircle
    The round status indicator on the left; clicking it completes or reopens the task.
    TaskDialog
    The window used both to add a new task and to edit an existing one.
    TaskDialog.Draft
    The values typed by the user.
    TaskDialog.Saver
    Saves a draft; implemented by the main window using the TaskService.
    TaskException
    Base class of the checked exceptions thrown by TaskService.
    TaskNotFoundException
    Thrown when an operation refers to a task id that does not exist, for example updating or deleting a task that was already removed.
    TaskRepository
    Abstraction over permanent storage of tasks.
    TaskService
    The business logic of the application: create, read, update and delete tasks, change their status, validate input, search / filter / sort, undo deletions and report statistics.
    TaskStats
    An immutable snapshot of how many tasks are in each state.
    TaskStatus
    The lifecycle state of a Task.
    Theme
    Central place for colours and fonts, with a light and a dark mode.
    Theme.Mode
    The two colour modes.
    Theme.Palette
    One complete set of colours.
    ThemedLabel
    A label whose colour is looked up from the theme every time it paints, so it changes instantly when the user switches between light and dark mode.
    Toasts
    Shows short "toast" messages at the bottom of the window.
    Toasts.Kind
    The kind of message, which decides the icon colour.
    ValidationException
    Thrown when user input breaks a rule, for example an empty title.
